items.titleZh: 维斯塔潘调侃拉塞尔的无线电对话走红
items.summaryZh: 在荷兰大奖赛排位赛后，马克斯·维斯塔潘与红牛工程师詹皮耶罗·兰比亚斯的一段无线电对话在网络上走红，他预判了乔治·拉塞尔可能会抱怨维修区放行，但这一抱怨并未发生。

items.originalTitle: 维斯塔潘调侃拉塞尔的无线电对话走红
items.summaryEn: After Dutch Grand Prix qualifying, a radio exchange between Max Verstappen and his Red Bull engineer Gianpiero Lambiase went viral, in which Verstappen predicted George Russell would complain about the pit release, but the complaint never came.
detailZh: 马克斯·维斯塔潘（维斯塔潘）关于乔治·拉塞尔（拉塞尔）的无线电玩笑在荷兰大奖赛排位赛后走红
马克斯·维斯塔潘在荷兰大奖赛排位赛期间关于乔治·拉塞尔的无线电玩笑已经走红
四届F1世界冠军马克斯·维斯塔潘发给他的红牛比赛工程师詹皮耶罗·兰比亚斯（Gianpiero Lambiase）的一条车队无线电信息，在赞德沃特的荷兰大奖赛排位赛后走红。
在排位赛期间，维斯塔潘预料到了梅赛德斯车手乔治·拉塞尔会提出投诉，但投诉实际上并没有出现。当车手们驶出维修区通道时，这位荷兰车手说：“我们可能会听到乔治在无线电里为维修区放行哭诉，但那其实一点也不危险。”
就转播画面所展示的内容来看，这位梅赛德斯车手并没有像维斯塔潘开玩笑预测的那样抱怨放车问题。
"什么都没做。被讨厌了。学学乔治吧，"一位车迷在Reddit上评论道，而另一位则补充说："大概是开玩笑吧，但我觉得如果乔治这么说的话，应该就不会被认为好笑了……"
"当拉塞尔的无线电打开时，维斯塔潘有点尴尬，因为他问的其实是天气。那些他过去用来挑衅的人已经比他更成熟了，不再上他那些把戏的当，"另一位车迷发帖说。
还有人评论道："抱怨对手可能会抱怨刚刚发生的情况，结果那位对手根本没抱怨。这是26年我最喜欢的一条信息，干得好GR。"
进一步的反应包括：“我确实喜欢Max的车队无线电，因为我喜欢GP一直保持冷静的样子，Max太搞笑了哈哈”，以及“我喜欢Max的俏皮劲儿”。另一条评论写道：“Max实在太逗了。”
迈凯伦的诺里斯拿下荷兰大奖赛杆位，Russell将与他共同排在头排。Verstappen排位第七，他的队友劳森——他顶替受伤的哈贾尔出战——将在第八位与他并肩发车。
荷兰大奖赛将于8月23日星期日下午3点（英国时间下午2点）举行。
detailEn: Max Verstappen's George Russell radio joke goes viral after Dutch GP qualifying
Max Verstappen's radio joke about George Russell during Dutch Grand Prix qualifying has gone viral
A team radio message from four-time Formula 1 champion Max Verstappen to his Red Bull race engineer Gianpiero Lambiase has gone viral after qualifying for the Dutch Grand Prix at Zandvoort.

During the qualifying session, Verstappen anticipated a complaint from Mercedes rival George Russell, which never actually came. As the drivers made their way out of the pitlane, the Dutchman said, "We'll probably have George crying on the radio about the pit release, but it was nothing unsafe."
As far as what was shown on the broadcast, the Mercedes driver did not complain about the pit release as Verstappen had jokingly predicted.
"Does nothing. Got hated. Be like George," one fan commented on Reddit, while another added: "Banter ig, but I bet it wouldn't be considered as funny if George said it..."

"It was a bit embarrassing for Verstappen when Russell's radio turned on, and he asked about the weather instead. The guys he used to bait just matured more than him and don't fall for his games anymore," another fan posted.
Someone else commented: "Complaining that a rival will probably complain about a scenario that just occurred, only for that rival not to complain. My favourite message of 26, well done GR."
Further reactions included: "I do like a Max radio just because I like how calm GP is all the time, very funny from Max lol," and "I love sassy Max." Another comment read: "Max is too funny."

McLaren's Lando Norris secured pole position for the Dutch Grand Prix and will be joined by Russell on the front row. Verstappen qualified seventh and his team-mate Liam Lawson, who has stepped in for an injured Isack Hadjar, will line up beside him in eighth.
The Dutch Grand Prix will take place at 3pm local time (2pm UK time) on Sunday 23 August.

items.titleZh: 汉密尔顿称法拉利小改动带来“难以置信”的提升
items.summaryZh: 汉密尔顿在荷兰大奖赛排位赛获得第五名后表示，法拉利赛车平衡性的显著改善让他对正赛更加乐观；队友勒克莱尔则对第六名的排位成绩不太满意。

items.originalTitle: 汉密尔顿称法拉利小改动带来“难以置信”的提升
items.summaryEn: Lewis Hamilton said a significant improvement in his Ferrari's balance left him more optimistic for the Dutch Grand Prix after qualifying fifth, while team mate Charles Leclerc was less happy after taking sixth on the grid.
detailZh: 刘易斯·汉密尔顿在排位赛中显著改善了法拉利赛车的平衡性后，对荷兰大奖赛的前景感到乐观。
他说，在排位赛中获得第五名后，他惊讶地发现赛车的感觉好了很多，而当天早些时候的冲刺赛中他仅获得第七名。
“我对赛车满意多了，”汉密尔顿说。“说实话，这太疯狂了。我们改变了很多东西，看起来并不大，但它在赛车中产生的差异令人难以置信。”
汉密尔顿表示，在冲刺赛排位赛之前，他在周末开始时对赛车感到满意。
“困难的是，我以第一名的成绩开始，信心十足，但在[冲刺赛]排位赛中我完全失去了信心，整个比赛过程中我对平衡性毫无信心。它不断地甩开我。
“然后我进入[大奖赛]排位赛，赛车就在那里，所以至少平衡性在那里。所以我一直在建立、建立、建立。[如果我们有]更多圈数，我想我们可能做得更好，但我认为最终轮胎是我们的问题。”
这位法拉利车手表示，他对“明天拥有这样的平衡性感到乐观得多”。
然而，他的队友查尔斯·勒克莱尔在冲刺赛中获得第二名后，对大奖赛排位赛仅获得第六名感到不太满意。
“我们真的必须看两件事，”他说。“第一件主要是我们从Q1到Q2再到Q3开始改变引擎模式。然后赛车在我下面做着不同的事情，这不是我喜欢的，我们可能在那里错过了一些性能。
“第二是我们所做的准备圈，其他人似乎没有做。我觉得如果没有那个准备圈，我的轮胎不会准备好，但我们必须保持开放的心态，看看其他人做了什么。”
detailEn: Lewis Hamilton is optimistic about his chances in the Dutch Grand Prix after making a significant improvement in his Ferrari’s balance in qualifying.
He said he was surprised how much better his car felt on his way to fifth on the grid in qualifying after finishing seventh in the sprint race earlier today.
“I’m so much happier with the car,” said Hamilton. “Honestly, it’s crazy. We changed a lot of things, it doesn’t really look that big, but the difference it makes in the car is unbelievable.”
Hamilton said he felt happy with the car at the beginning of the weekend before qualifying for the sprint race.

“The difficult thing is I started P1 with good confidence, I lost it all in [sprint race] qualifying and all through the race I had no confidence in the balance. It was constantly breaking away from me.

“Then I go into [grand prix] qualifying and the car’s there, so the balance is there at least. So I was building and building and building. [If we had] some more laps I think we could have probably done better but I think ultimately the tyres were the issue for us.”
The Ferrari driver said he feels “a lot more optimistic for tomorrow with the balance that I have.”
However his team mate Charles Leclerc, who finished second in the sprint race, was less happy after taking sixth on the grid for the grand prix.

“We’ll have to look at two things, really,” he said. “The first one is mostly the fact that we started changing engine modes from Q1 to Q2 to Q3. Then the car is just doing different things underneath me, which is not something I enjoy, and we’ve probably missed a bit of performance there.

“Second is the prep[aration] lap that we have done that the others seem to not have done. I don’t feel like my tyres would have been ready without that preparation lap, but we’ve got to be open-minded and look at what the others have done.”
keyPointsZh: 汉密尔顿在冲刺赛排位和正赛中缺乏信心，赛车平衡不断失控，但大奖赛排位赛中平衡恢复。
勒克莱尔对排位赛第六名不满，指出引擎模式从Q1到Q3的切换让赛车表现不一致，且他做的准备圈可能影响了轮胎状态。
keyPointsEn: Hamilton lacked confidence in the car's balance during sprint qualifying and the sprint race, but the balance returned in grand prix qualifying.
Leclerc was unhappy with sixth on the grid, noting that switching engine modes from Q1 to Q3 made the car behave differently and that his preparation lap may have affected his tyres.

items.titleZh: 安东内利因1号弯失误错失荷兰大奖赛杆位
items.summaryZh: 荷兰大奖赛排位赛中，F1冠军领跑者、梅赛德斯车手基米·安东内利因1号弯失误错失杆位，对此感到沮丧，最终以第三位发车。

items.originalTitle: 安东内利对荷兰大奖赛杆位失误感到沮丧
items.summaryEn: Formula 1 championship leader Kimi Antonelli was frustrated after a mistake at Turn 1 cost him pole position in Dutch Grand Prix qualifying, leaving the Mercedes driver to start third. He qualified 0.133s behind McLaren polesitter Lando Norris and 0.031s behind team-mate George Russell.
detailZh: 安东内利 在1号弯的"失误"让他错失荷兰大奖赛杆位后感到沮丧
这位梅赛德斯车手将从第三位发车，参加周日的荷兰大奖赛，排在 诺里斯 和队友 拉塞尔 之后
安东内利 对自己在荷兰大奖赛排位赛中的表现感到沮丧，这位F1积分榜领跑者因在1号弯的失误而错失杆位。
这位梅赛德斯车手排位赛成绩比迈凯轮杆位得主 诺里斯 慢0.133秒，比排名第二的队友 拉塞尔 慢0.031秒，因此将从第三位发车，参加周日在赞德沃特举行的比赛。
安东内利认为自己“本来有机会争夺杆位”，但在Q3末段雨水即将来临时——他在第一轮跑出第四后——进入1号弯发卡弯时收油收得太多了。
“我在第一个计时段损失了两分之几秒，所以很遗憾，”这位19岁的车手告诉天空体育意大利台。“这是一场艰难的排位赛：我很难找到合适的感觉，尤其是车尾方面。
“这是那种我们完全没有动车的排位赛之一，通常随着排位赛进行，你会开始加大尾翼来帮助车子更好地转向。
“今天情况并非如此，因为我依然很挣扎，但我相信在Q3我有机会去争夺杆位。”
“遗憾的是，我在1号弯犯了一个错误，尤其是看到下雨后，可以说我进弯太慢了，损失了很多时间。所以这是我自己的失误，但最终还是拿到了第三名。”
诺里斯（迈凯伦）、拉塞尔（梅赛德斯）、安东内利（梅赛德斯）
对这位意大利车手来说，这个本已令人失望的周末还在继续，他在周五的冲刺赛排位赛中因SQ1倒数第二个弯角冲出赛道而遭遇底板受损。
这让他损失了“25分”的下压力，导致他在周六的正赛中仅排第五位发车，最终获得第四名，落后于冠军Russell、法拉利的勒克莱尔和Norris。
“我犯了一个错误，这肯定让我失去了一些信心，”安东内利说。“而且今天的排位赛也是，主要是我对这辆车的感觉不太好。我仍然很难找到自己的节奏，把单圈时间做好。”
但周日——这将是最後一届荷兰大奖赛——给了安东内利一个反弹的机会，他可以将自己与第五位发车的刘易斯·汉密尔顿之间53分的积分领先优势进一步扩大。
“取得一个好的发车位置肯定很重要，然后尝试给前面的车手施加压力，也许在策略上做一些不同的选择，”领先第三名的拉塞尔56分的安东内利在意大利天空体育的采访中补充道。
“在比赛阶段对轮胎的管理也会很重要，但我必须说，明天我们有一个很好的机会取得好成绩。”
“心态是一样的：进攻，但要动脑子。如果机会出现，就抓住它。否则，就等待并观察局势如何发展。但我绝对不想跑一场防守型的比赛。”
detailEn: Kimi Antonelli frustrated after Turn 1 "mistake" cost him Dutch GP pole
The Mercedes driver will start Sunday's Dutch Grand Prix from third behind Lando Norris and team-mate George Russell
Kimi Antonelli was frustrated with himself after qualifying for the Dutch Grand Prix as the Formula 1 championship leader missed out on pole due to a mistake at Turn 1.
The Mercedes driver will start Sunday’s race at Zandvoort from third after qualifying 0.133s off McLaren polesitter Lando Norris and 0.031s behind team-mate George Russell in second.
Antonelli reckons he “had a shot for pole” but at the end of Q3 when rain was looming - after taking fourth with his first run - he backed off too much heading into the Turn 1 hairpin.

“I lost two tenths [in the first sector], so that's a shame,” the 19-year-old told Sky Sports Italy. “It was a difficult qualifying session: I struggled to find the right feel, especially with the rear.
“It was one of those qualifying sessions where we didn’t touch the car, and usually, as the session progresses, you start adding wing to help it turn more.

梅赛德斯与乔治·拉塞尔和基米·安东内利续约至2027年，红牛也与马克斯·维斯塔潘续约；如今，托托·沃尔夫认为，他要再过几年才会有下一次抢走这位四届世界冠军的机会。

如果梅赛德斯在2014年击败红牛，锁定这位年轻人的未来，F1的历史可能会完全不同。当时维斯塔潘作为单座赛车新秀在F3中不断赢下比赛，但他的目标坚定地锁定在立即完成世界冠军赛首秀上。这是只有红牛才能提供的机会，凭借其第二支车队。
自那以后，梅赛德斯和维斯塔潘一直是对手，但两年前，沃尔夫透露他曾与当时的三届世界冠军进行过会谈。这位奥地利人面临着为即将转投法拉利的刘易斯·汉密尔顿寻找合适替代者的艰巨任务，并且已经把目光投向了下一代天才基米·安东内利，但如果签下维斯塔潘有一丝可能实现，他显然不会放过这个机会。
最终没有实现，但当Autosport问沃尔夫，是否仍会在心里考虑潜在签下维斯塔潘时，沃尔夫坚称大门并未关闭：“是的，会。不知怎的，我有那种感觉。但我不知道那会是什么时候。是26年，还是三年后，我还不知道。”

“这是否意味着因为时机不对，我们的道路永远不会交汇？嗯，那是可能发生的，”沃尔夫当时思索道。“但那可能是50%。另外50%是，我们会在各自职业生涯的某个阶段一起比赛，如果这对双方都合适的话。”

Mercedes extended its deals with George Russell and Kimi Antonelli for 2027, and so did Red Bull with Max Verstappen; by now, Toto Wolff believes it will be a few years until he gets another chance to snatch the four-time champion away

Will Max Verstappen ever race for Mercedes in Formula 1? This is what team principal Toto Wolff is quizzed about in his yearly media session with Dutch journalists at Zandvoort – and this time the door looks closed, though Wolff keeps it ever so slightly ajar.

F1’s history could have panned out very differently if Mercedes had beaten Red Bull to secure the youngster’s future back in 2014, as Verstappen kept winning races in Formula 3 as a single-seater rookie, but his sights were firmly set on an immediate world championship debut. That’s something only Red Bull could offer, courtesy of its second outfit.

Since then, Mercedes and Verstappen have always been rivals, but two years ago, Wolff revealed he had held talks with the then-three-time world champion. The Austrian faced the tall order of finding a worthy replacement for Ferrari-bound Lewis Hamilton and had already set his sights on next-generation wunderkind Kimi Antonelli, but he obviously wouldn’t have passed on the opportunity of recruiting Verstappen, had it had the slightest chance of materialising.

It didn’t, but Wolff insisted the door was not closed, when asked by Autosport if a potential move for Verstappen was still in the back of his mind: “Yes, it is. Somehow I have that feeling. But I don't know when that could be. Whether it's '26, whether it's three years later, I don't know yet.”
Wolff again sounded out Verstappen one year later, as rookie Antonelli struggled in his maiden season, but the Red Bull racer pledged loyalty anew to the Milton Keynes-based team.

“Could that mean our paths will never cross because the timings are wrong? Well, that can happen,” Wolff pondered at the time. “But that could be 50%. The other 50% is we are racing together at a certain stage in our careers, if it is right for both sides.”

But by now, Wolff admits he can’t see Verstappen joining Mercedes anytime soon, after Russell and Antonelli were confirmed in the Silver Arrows for 2027 back in June, while the Dutchman’s new Red Bull deal was announced ahead of his home race – despite Verstappen currently going through his first winless campaign since 2015.

“Pretty early we felt for us that being with George and Kimi was the right decision to continue – for various reasons, but it seems that the driver line-up is just the right positive dynamic,” Wolff commented. “It allows Kimi to grow and for George to bring out his best game because he has a quick, young team-mate.

“Therefore it seemed pretty logical that Max would stay with Red Bull. Better the devil you know – that's a punchline! – and then wait what happens in two or three years, where contracts open up again and probably his options are not just one team but maybe three or four at a time. And wait who performs the best.”

Asked by Autosport if Mercedes had had any chance at all of hiring Verstappen for 2027, Wolff explained: “Pretty early in the late spring it was clear that we would continue like we do. And we have an open and in a way most transparent relationship as we can have. So the situation, as you say, was very different to what it was last year, where both sides were exploring whether cooperation could happen or not.”

The announcement of Verstappen’s new contract ended speculation over the four-time world champion’s future, after he emerged among drivers as arguably the most critical of F1’s new regulations. Cryptic, throwaway lines about “life” decisions to make fuelled rumours amid his involvement in GT3 racing, but in the end, Red Bull’s superstar decided to keep his F1 career going.

Asked if he was surprised to see Verstappen staying longer in the series, Wolff said: “No. The more regulations mature the more the teams will catch up. And even if Red Bull at the moment is on the back foot it is clear that, give it some time, they will shine.

“They have had strong races this year, others that were not. But I have no doubt that going forward the usual suspects will be again fighting for wins and championships, whether it is Ferrari or McLaren or Red Bull or ourselves. So the decision’s in a way logical one for me.”

Asked by Motorsport.com if Mercedes had had any chance at all of hiring Verstappen for 2027, Wolff explained: “Pretty early in the late spring it was clear that we would continue like we do. And we have an open and in a way most transparent relationship as we can have. So the situation, as you say, was very different to what it was last year, where both sides were exploring whether cooperation could happen or not.”

The announcement of Verstappen’s new contract ended speculation over the four-time world champion’s future, after he emerged among drivers as arguably the most critical of F1’s new regulations. Cryptic, throwaway lines about “life” decisions to make fuelled rumours amid his involvement in GT3 racing, but in the end, Red Bull’s superstar decided to keep his F1 career going.

Asked if he was surprised to see Verstappen staying longer in the series, Wolff said: “No. The more regulations mature the more the teams will catch up. And even if Red Bull at the moment is on the back foot it is clear that, give it some time, they will shine.

“They have had strong races this year, others that were not. But I have no doubt that going forward the usual suspects will be again fighting for wins and championships, whether it is Ferrari or McLaren or Red Bull or ourselves. So the decision’s in a way logic for me.”

items.titleZh: 斯特罗尔评本田F1引擎升级："远远不够"
items.summaryZh: 在荷兰大奖赛冲刺赛排位赛中，阿斯顿·马丁两车止步Q1，兰斯·斯特罗尔认为本田升级版引擎的进步"远远不够"。
items.originalTitle: 斯特罗尔评本田F1引擎升级：“远远不够”
items.summaryEn: After both Aston Martin cars were eliminated in Q1 of sprint qualifying at the Dutch Grand Prix, Lance Stroll said Honda's upgraded engine is "not nearly enough" of a step forward.
detailZh: 兰斯·斯特罗尔认为，在本田升级后的F1引擎上，阿斯顿·马丁在荷兰大奖赛排位赛第一节双双出局之后，这一进步“远远不够”。
阿斯顿·马丁的两辆赛车都在周五冲刺赛排位赛的第一阶段被淘汰，但原本期望更高，因为这是新车队周末上本田新引擎正式运行的第一天——不过费尔南多·阿隆索在冲刺赛排位赛中尾翼的直道模式出现了故障。
虽然第一轮之后速度有所提升，阿隆索排名第12，但最终两位阿斯顿·马丁车手都没能进入第二节排位赛，阿隆索只差了0.1秒。
斯特罗尔比阿隆索慢了0.15秒，在排位赛结束后被问及本田“小小的一步”进步时，他给出了一个略显悲观的评价。
当《The 比赛》问到斯特罗尔是否能感觉到车有进步时，他说：“我觉得没有太大进步。也许有一点点，但远远不够。”
“在底盘方面，我认为我们相当不错。我们在布达佩斯迈出了一大步。油门的可控性和动力是我们接下来真正需要努力的地方。”
他说发动机方面“仍然有很多问题”，也就是可控性问题，这让阿斯顿·马丁在弯道入弯时非常难以预测。
谈到油门可控性时，斯特罗尔说：“不好，不好。这就像抽奖一样。现在，我们就是得不到稳定的发动机制动，入弯时还有很多降档被拒绝的情况。所以，是的，问题很多。”
阿隆索：阿斯顿·马丁迈出了“惊人的”一步
阿隆索觉得，如果他的最后一组飞驰圈之前的那圈（出圈）跑得更好，还能再快大约0.1秒，可惜那一圈没能刷新他之前的最好成绩。
但对比阿斯顿·马丁与奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里的迈凯伦在第一节排位赛（Q1）最快圈速之间已大幅缩小的差距时，他远没有感到失望。
“皮亚斯特里在Q1拿到第一，比我们快1.3秒——而我们过去平均落后领先者4.5秒，所以我们在两站比赛里提高了三秒，”阿隆索解释道。
"这太棒了。一切都按预期运转，但这是一项艰难的运动。你必须始终保持进步。"
他同意斯特罗尔的看法，即如果本田能改善新动力单元的可操控性，还能找到更多时间，但这只能在本田位于日本樱（Sakura）的基地完成。
阿隆索补充道："遗憾的是，在赛道这边，我们无能为力。我们必须依靠工厂、软件或其他方面的一些重大改进。"
"这些必须来自日本，所以不可能一蹴而就。更接近意大利大奖赛（蒙扎）的时候，我们需要在那里再找到一步的提升。整个套件里还有零点几秒的优化空间。"
至于阿斯顿·马丁从第18和第19位发车的比赛前景，阿隆索说：“看看吧。通常我们在比赛节奏上表现更好，因为我们的底盘非常出色。
“当（对手）在正赛中使用旧轮胎或较旧的轮胎时，我们更多依靠底盘的良好抓地力，而不那么依赖轮胎和轮胎抓地力。
“我们可以做得更好，但与此同时我们在直道上无法完成超越。在这方面我们处于困难的位置，但我们会尽力而为。”
本田的赛道总经理兼总工程师折原慎太郎说：“今天我们使用新规格引擎参加了冲刺赛和排位赛，没有出现任何可靠性问题。
“在这些练习环节之后，我们从两位阿斯顿·马丁车手那里收到了类似的反馈。
结合我们工程师的评估，以及我们在樱田HRC（HRC Sakura）试验台上于夜间和冲刺赛之后开展的工作，我们已经取得了一些改进，能够更好地控制内燃机（ICE），并进一步提升排位赛中燃烧表现的一致性。
我们需要确保发动机能在正确的时机满足车手的需求。我们今天已经采取了一些措施，但要让车手获得所需的信心，还有更多工作要做。
这是我们短期和中期工作的首要重点。”
detailEn: Lance Stroll believes Honda’s upgraded Formula 1 engine is “not nearly enough” of a step forward after Aston Martin’s double Q1 elimination at the Dutch Grand Prix.

Aston Martin lost both cars in the first stage of sprint qualifying on Friday, but hopes were higher given that it was the first proper day of the new Honda engine running on a race weekend - plus the caveat of Fernando Alonso’s straight mode not working on his rear wing in sprint qualifying.
And while the pace was better after the first runs, with Alonso 12th, ultimately both Aston Martin drivers fell short of a Q2 place, with Alonso a tenth adrift.
Stroll was a tenth and a half behind Alonso and delivered a somewhat bleak verdict on Honda’s “small step” forward when quizzed about it after qualifying.
“Not so much, I think. Maybe a bit, but not nearly enough,” Stroll said, when asked by The Race if he could feel a step forward.
“On the chassis side, I think we're quite good. We made a big step in Budapest. The driveability and the power is the next thing we need to really work on.”
He said there are “still a lot of issues on the engine side”, namely the driveability problems, which is making the Aston Martin very unpredictable on corner entries.

“Not good, not good. It's a lottery,” Stroll said of the driveability. “Right now, we're just not getting the consistent engine braking, going into the corner and a lot of rejected downshifts. So, yeah, a lot of issues.”
Alonso: Aston Martin has taken "amazing" step
Alonso felt like there was around a tenth more on the table with a better outlap for his final run, which wasn’t an improvement on his previous best.
But he was far from disappointed when comparing the much-reduced gap between Aston Martin and the ultimate Q1 pace of Oscar Piastri's McLaren.
“Piastri P1 in Q1 was 1.3 seconds in front of us - we used to be 4.5 seconds average on the gap to the leader, so we improved three seconds in two races," Alonso explained.
"This is amazing. Everything is working as expected, but this is a tough sport. You need to always keep improving.”
He agreed with Stroll that there’s more time to be found if Honda can improve the driveability of the new power unit, but that can only be done at Honda’s Sakura base in Japan.
“Unfortunately, here on the track side, there is not much we can do," Alonso added. "We need to rely on some big changes in the factory or software or whatever is needed.
"This has to come from Japan, so it's not from one day to the next. It's more towards Monza where we need to find another step there. There are a couple of tenths to optimise in the package.”
As for Aston Martin’s prospects for the race from 18th and 19th on the grid, Alonso said: “Let's see. Normally we are doing better on the race pace because our chassis is very good.
“When [rivals] have old tyres or older tyres in the race, we rely more on our good grip from the chassis and we don't rely so much on the tyres and grip.
"We can do a better job, but at the same time we cannot overtake on the straights. We are in a difficult position there, but we try our best.”
Honda's trackside general manager and chief engineer Shintaro Orihara said: “Today we ran the sprint race and qualifying without any reliability issues with the new spec engine.
"We have received similar feedback from both Aston Martin drivers after these sessions.

"Together, with our engineers’ assessments, and our work on the test bench at HRC Sakura overnight and after the sprint race, we have seen some improvements to get a better control over the internal combustion engine (ICE) and to further improve the consistency of the combustion behaviour in qualifying.
"We need to ensure that the engine does what the driver needs at the right time. We have taken some steps today, but there is still more to be done to give the drivers the confidence they need.
"This is our primary focus for the short and medium term.”

items.summaryEn: Lando Norris beat George Russell by 0.102s to take pole position for the Dutch Grand Prix, with F1 championship leader Kimi Antonelli completing the top three.
detailZh: F1荷兰大奖赛：诺里斯力压拉塞尔夺得杆位
兰多·诺里斯在上一站布达佩斯之后，取得了他在F1 2026赛季的第二个杆位
兰多·诺里斯力压乔治·拉塞尔，夺得荷兰大奖赛杆位，F1冠军领跑者基米·安东内利位列第三。
这位卫冕世界冠军以0.102秒的优势击败了冲刺赛冠军拉塞尔，为迈凯伦强势的排位赛画上句号，这支卫冕冠军车队在赞德福特赛道统治了每一节排位赛。
此前，同样在Q2排名第一的诺里斯已经以1分11秒344的成绩暂列杆位，这比拉塞尔快了0.151秒，而奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里以0.2秒之差位列第三。
在此之前，本节排位赛一直在干燥条件下进行，但雨水即将降临这条海滨赛道，导致多辆赛车很快驶出维修区，准备在Q3进行第二圈。
不过这确实造成了一些麻烦，诺里斯和拉塞尔同时进入赛道，在剩余五分钟时，两人在出场圈中被看到互相竞速。
诺里斯率先冲过终点线，在最后一圈将成绩提升至1分11秒163，尽管拉塞尔也刷新了自己的成绩，但仅为1分11秒265。
他们取代了曾短暂登上成绩榜首位的安东内利，拉塞尔的梅赛德斯队友最终落后杆位0.133秒，皮亚斯特里则位列第四。
这位澳大利亚车手落后队友诺里斯0.142秒，第三排将全部由法拉利占据，刘易斯·汉密尔顿位列第五，落后0.331秒，查尔斯·勒克莱尔位列第六，落后杆位0.395秒。
第七名属于红牛的本土英雄马克斯·维斯塔潘，他落后诺里斯0.455秒，将与临时队友利亚姆·劳森共享第四排，劳森正在替代受伤的伊萨克·哈贾尔。
加布里埃尔·博尔托莱托为奥迪车队位列第九，表现亮眼的小红牛新秀阿尔维德·林德布拉德在当天取得连续第五次Q3出场后，跻身前十。
皮埃尔·加斯利距离Q3仅差0.1秒，为阿尔派车队位列第11，将与重返F1的前队友、小红牛替补车手角田裕毅共享第六排。
尼科·霍肯伯格在最后时刻提升成绩，使这位奥迪老将位列第13，这意味着加斯利的队友弗兰科·科拉平托跌至第14，领先哈斯车手埃斯特班·奥康位列第15。
赞德福特是自去年5月迈阿密-伊莫拉-摩纳哥以来，承受压力的奥康首次连续两场排位赛击败队友奥利弗·贝尔曼。
Q2淘汰区的最后一位是亚历克斯·阿尔本，他的队友卡洛斯·塞恩斯连续第二次在Q1出局，在签下威廉姆斯续约合同的这个周末位列第17。
相对而言，阿斯顿·马丁的情况更为积极，尽管在冲刺赛阶段存在驾驶性问题，但车队确认其升级后的引擎和底盘已取得进步。
费尔南多·阿隆索位列第18，队友兰斯·斯特罗尔位列第19，而贝尔曼对哈斯已退步为“第二差车队”的担忧成为现实，他排位第20。
这仅领先于新加入的凯迪拉克，后者距离进入Q2还差1秒，落后皮亚斯特里Q1标杆成绩1.7秒，瓦尔特利·博塔斯位列第21，塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯位列第22。
detailEn: F1 Dutch GP: Norris pips Russell to grab pole
Lando Norris achieved his second pole of F1 2026 after Budapest last time out
Lando Norris has pipped George Russell to pole position for the Dutch Grand Prix with Formula 1 championship leader Kimi Antonelli rounding out the top three.
The reigning world champion beat sprint winner Russell by 0.102s to cap off a strong qualifying for McLaren, as the defending champions had topped every session at Zandvoort.
It came after Norris, who also topped Q2, had already claimed provisional pole with a 1m11.344s and that was 0.151s quicker than Russell with Oscar Piastri two tenths off in third.
Until then the session had been held in dry conditions but rain was about to fall down on the seaside track, causing a flurry of cars to soon leave the pitlane for their second laps in Q3.
This did cause some trouble though, as Norris and Russell entered the track at the same time and were seen racing each other on their out-laps with five minutes remaining.
Norris was first to cross the line, improving to a 1m11.163s on his final tour, and although Russell also bettered his time, it was only to a 1m11.265s.
They displaced Antonelli who had briefly gone to the top of the timesheet and Russell’s Mercedes team-mate was eventually 0.133s off pole with Piastri taking fourth.
The Australian was 0.142s behind team-mate Norris and it will be an all-Ferrari third row with Lewis Hamilton in fifth, 0.331s off the pace, and Charles Leclerc sixth, 0.395s behind pole.
Seventh went to Red Bull’s home hero Max Verstappen, who was 0.455s behind Norris, and he will share the fourth row with temporary team-mate Liam Lawson as he is replacing the injured Isack Hadjar.
Gabriel Bortoleto qualified ninth for Audi and impressive Racing Bulls rookie Arvid Lindblad rounded out the top 10 on the day he achieved his fifth, straight Q3 appearance.
Pierre Gasly was just a tenth away from Q3 as he took 11th for Alpine and will share the sixth row with former team-mate and Racing Bulls stand-in Yuki Tsunoda upon his F1 return.
A late improvement from Nico Hulkenberg left the Audi veteran in 13th, meaning Gasly’s team-mate Franco Colapinto dropped to 14th ahead of Haas driver Esteban Ocon in 15th.
Zandvoort marks the first time since Miami-Imola-Monaco in May last year that the under pressure Ocon has outqualified team-mate Oliver Bearman on consecutive occasions.
Rounding out the Q2 drop zone was Alex Albon, whose team-mate Carlos Sainz suffered a second, consecutive Q1 exit as he took 17th on the weekend he’s signed a Williams contract extension.
Relatively speaking it was more positive for Aston Martin, who confirmed the step forward it has made with its upgraded engine and chassis despite drivability woes in the sprint sessions.
Fernando Alonso took 18th with team-mate Lance Stroll in 19th, while Bearman’s fears that Haas had regressed to becoming the ‘second-worst team’ came true as he qualified 20th.
That was ahead of only newcomer Cadillac, which was a second off making it into Q2 and 1.7s behind Piastri’s Q1 benchmark, with Valtteri Bottas taking 21st and Sergio Perez sitting in 22nd.

items.originalTitle: 诺里斯惊险夺得荷兰大奖赛杆位
items.summaryEn: Lando Norris claimed back-to-back pole positions by topping qualifying for Formula 1's Dutch Grand Prix, beating the Mercedes duo, with drivers setting their final Q3 laps early in anticipation of rain.
detailZh: 兰多·诺里斯在F1荷兰大奖赛排位赛中夺得杆位，实现连续两站杆位，击败了梅赛德斯车队的两位车手。
诺里斯在赞德沃特以1分11.163秒的Q3成绩夺得杆位，仅领先冲刺赛冠军拉塞尔十分之一秒多一点。
诺里斯和拉塞尔都在Q3最后一圈相对提前完成，以应对排位赛末段可能到来的降雨，最终迈凯伦车手诺里斯成绩最快。
积分榜领跑者基米·安东内利排名第三，仅落后拉塞尔0.031秒；奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里位居第四，落后迈凯伦队友约一秒半。
刘易斯·汉密尔顿和夏尔·勒克莱尔的最后一圈稍晚一些做出，但最终分别排在第五和第六，汉密尔顿是领先车队中最后一个做出成绩的，并在过程中超越了勒克莱尔。
红牛车队的马克斯·维斯塔潘排名第七，他的临时队友利亚姆·劳森表现出色，获得第八，仅比他慢十分之一秒多一点。
奥迪车队的加布里埃尔·博托莱托以第九名领跑中游集团的争夺，排在阿维德·林德布拉德的小红牛之前。
皮埃尔·加斯利曾在冲刺赛排位赛和冲刺赛中位居中游车手之首，但在升级后的阿尔派赛车上表现挣扎，未能进入Q3，最终排在第11位。
小红牛的替补车手角田裕毅排在第12位，领先于霍肯伯格的奥迪以及驾驶旧规格阿尔派的科拉平托。
Albon实现了队内排位赛的背靠背胜利，以0.022秒的优势击败队友塞恩斯晋级Q2，而Sainz则在第17位被淘汰。
Albon最终排在第16位，是Q2中最慢的车手，落后奥康的哈斯半个十分之一秒。
升级后的阿斯顿·马丁 Honda未能进入Q2
升级版本田引擎在阿斯顿·马丁赛车尾部的表现比在冲刺排位赛中要好，费尔南多·阿隆索以第12名结束Q1，等待最后一轮出场。
然而阿隆索在最后一圈未能提升成绩，最终以第18名被淘汰，排在队友兰斯·斯特罗尔之前。
奥利·贝尔曼的哈斯赛车仅排第20位——这是他今年最差的排位赛成绩——排在两辆凯迪拉克之前，其中瓦尔特利·博塔斯连续第五次排位赛领先队友。
detailEn: Lando Norris made it back-to-back pole positions by topping qualifying at Formula 1’s Dutch Grand Prix, beating the Mercedes duo.
Norris took pole at Zandvoort with a 1m11.163s in Q3 to best sprint race winner Russell by just over a tenth of a second.
Norris and Russell were among those to set their final Q3 laps relatively in anticipation of rain at the end end of the session, with the McLaren driver ending up quickest.
Championship leader Kimi Antonelli was third fastest, just 0.031s shy of Russell, with Oscar Piastri fourth, a tenth and a half adrift of his McLaren team-mate.
Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc set their final laps slightly later but ended up fifth and sixth with Hamilton the last of the leading teams to set a time, jumping Leclerc in the process.
Max Verstappen was seventh for Red Bull with his stand-in team-mate Liam Lawson doing a solid job to qualify eighth, just over a tenth slower.
Audi’s Gabriel Bortoleto led the midfield fight in ninth ahead of Arvid Lindblad’s Racing Bulls.
Having been the top midfielder in sprint qualifying and the sprint race, Pierre Gasly struggled in the upgraded Alpine, missing out of Q3 and ended up 11th.
Racing Bulls stand-in Yuki Tsunoda was 12th ahead of Nico Hulkenberg’s Audi and Franco Colapinto in the older spec Alpine.
Albon Albon made it back-to-back intra-team qualifying victories, beating team-mate Carlos Sainz by 0.022s to advance into Q2 while Sainz was knocked out in 17th place.
Albon ended up 16th as the slowest driver in Q2, half a tenth behind Esteban Ocon’s Haas.
Upgraded Aston Martin Honda falls short of Q2
The upgraded Honda engine went better in the back of the Aston Martins than it did in sprint qualifying, with Fernando Alonso 12th ahead of the final runs in Q1.
However Alonso couldn’t improve on his final lap and ended up being eliminated in 18th place, just ahead of team-mate Lance Stroll.
Ollie Bearman’s Haas was 20th - his worst qualifying of the year - ahead of the two Cadillacs, led by Valtteri Bottas for the fifth consecutive qualifying session.

detailZh: F1荷兰大奖赛：兰多·诺里斯险胜乔治·拉塞尔夺得统治性杆位，雨季威胁逼近
诺里斯继上一站布达佩斯之后，拿下自己2026年F1赛季的第二个杆位
兰多·诺里斯险胜乔治·拉塞尔，夺得荷兰大奖赛杆位，F1积分榜领跑者基米·安东内利位列第三。
这位卫冕世界冠军以0.102秒的优势击败冲刺赛冠军拉塞尔，为迈凯伦画上完美排位赛的句号，这支卫冕冠军车队在赞德沃特的每个阶段都位居榜首。
此前，同样在第二节排位赛中排名榜首的诺里斯已经以1分11.344秒的成绩占据临时杆位，比拉塞尔快了0.151秒，而皮亚斯特里落后两秒的十分之二（0.2秒）位居第三。
在此之前，排位赛一直在干燥条件下进行，但雨即将降临这座海滨赛道，导致大量赛车很快驶出维修通道，进行第三节排位赛的第二个飞驰圈。
不过这也造成了一些麻烦，因为诺里斯和拉塞尔在同一时间进入赛道，在还剩五分钟时，两人被看到在出场圈上互相较劲。
两人最终摆脱了彼此，诺里斯率先冲过计时线，在最后一圈将成绩提升至1分11.163秒，尽管拉塞尔也刷新了自己的成绩，但只做到1分11.265秒。
他们挤掉了安东内利，后者曾一度登顶计时榜，而拉塞尔在梅赛德斯的队友最终落后杆位0.133秒，皮亚斯特里获得第四。
这位澳大利亚车手落后队友诺里斯0.142秒，第三排将由法拉利包揽：刘易斯·汉密尔顿第五，落后标杆0.331秒，夏尔·勒克莱尔第六，落后杆位0.395秒。
第七名是红牛的主场英雄马克斯·维斯塔潘，他落后诺里斯0.455秒，他将与临时队友利亚姆·劳森共享第四排，后者正在顶替受伤的伊萨克·哈贾尔。
加布里埃尔·博托莱托为奥迪拿下第九，表现出色的小红牛新秀阿维德·林德布拉德位列前十，当天他实现了连续第五次进入第三节排位赛（Q3）。
皮埃尔·加斯利距离Q3仅差十分之一秒，最终以第11名为阿尔派发车，并将与他的前队友、代表小红牛出赛的角田裕毅共同分享第六排发车位，后者将在本次F1回归中亮相。
尼科·霍肯伯格在最后时刻提升了成绩，使这位奥迪老将以第13名完赛，这意味着加斯利的队友弗朗哥·科拉平托跌至第14名，排在哈斯车手埃斯特班·奥康（第15名）之前。
赞德沃特站是自去年5月的迈阿密—伊莫拉—摩纳哥三连赛以来，饱受压力的奥康首次连续两站排位赛战胜队友奥利弗·贝尔曼。
排位赛Q2淘汰区的最后一名是亚历克斯·阿尔本，而他的队友卡洛斯·塞恩斯在签下威廉姆斯续约合同的这个周末，连续第二次在Q1出局，仅获得第17名。
相对来说，这对阿斯顿·马丁来说更积极一些，尽管在冲刺赛练习中的可驾驶性存在问题，但车队确认了升级后的引擎和底盘所带来的进步。
费尔南多·阿隆索排在第18位，队友兰斯·斯特罗尔位列第19，而比尔曼担心哈斯已经退步成“第二差的车队”，这一担忧成真了，他排位赛仅列第20位。
他只排在了新军凯迪拉克之前，后者距离进入第二节排位赛（Q2）还差一秒，比皮亚斯特里在第一节排位赛（Q1）中的标杆成绩慢了1.7秒，瓦尔特利·博塔斯排在第21位，塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯则位列第22位。
detailEn: F1 Dutch GP: Lando Norris pips George Russell to dominant pole as rain threat looms
Norris achieved his second pole of F1 2026 after Budapest last time out
Lando Norris pipped George Russell to pole position for the Dutch Grand Prix with Formula 1 championship leader Kimi Antonelli rounding out the top three.
The reigning world champion beat sprint winner Russell by 0.102s to cap off a perfect qualifying for McLaren, as the defending champions had topped every session at Zandvoort.
It came after Norris, who also topped Q2, had already claimed provisional pole with a 1m11.344s and that was 0.151s quicker than Russell with Oscar Piastri two tenths off in third.
Until then, the session had been held in dry conditions but rain was about to fall down on the seaside track, causing a flurry of cars to soon leave the pitlane for their second laps in Q3.
This did cause some trouble though, as Norris and Russell entered the track at identical times and were seen racing each other on their outlaps with five minutes remaining.
Both finally got rid of each other and Norris was first to cross the line, improving to a 1m11.163s on his final tour and although Russell also bettered his own time, it was only to a 1m11.265s.
They displaced Antonelli who had briefly gone to the top of the timesheet and Russell’s Mercedes team-mate was eventually 0.133s off pole with Piastri taking fourth.
The Australian was 0.142s behind team-mate Norris and it will be an all-Ferrari third row with Lewis Hamilton in fifth, 0.331s off the pace, and Charles Leclerc sixth, 0.395s behind pole.
Seventh went to Red Bull’s home hero Max Verstappen, who was 0.455s behind Norris, and he will share the fourth row with temporary team-mate Liam Lawson as he is replacing the injured Isack Hadjar.
Gabriel Bortoleto qualified ninth for Audi and impressive Racing Bulls rookie Arvid Lindblad rounded out the top 10 on the day he achieved his fifth, straight Q3 appearance.
Pierre Gasly was just a tenth away from Q3 as he took 11th for Alpine and will share the sixth row with former team-mate and Racing Bulls stand-in Yuki Tsunoda upon his F1 return.
A late improvement from Nico Hulkenberg left the Audi veteran in 13th, meaning Gasly’s team-mate Franco Colapinto dropped to 14th ahead of Haas driver Esteban Ocon in 15th.
Zandvoort marks the first time since Miami-Imola-Monaco in May last year that the under pressure Ocon has outqualified team-mate Oliver Bearman on consecutive occasions.
Rounding out the Q2 drop zone was Alex Albon, whose team-mate Carlos Sainz suffered a second, consecutive Q1 exit as he took 17th on the weekend he’s signed a Williams extension.
Relatively speaking, it was more positive for Aston Martin, who confirmed the step forward it has made with its upgraded engine and chassis despite drivability woes in the sprint sessions.
Fernando Alonso took 18th with team-mate Lance Stroll in 19th, while Bearman’s fears that Haas had regressed to becoming the ‘second worst team’ came true as he qualified 20th.
That was ahead of only newcomer Cadillac, which was a second off Q2 and 1.7s behind Piastri’s Q1 benchmark with Valtteri Bottas taking 21st and Sergio Perez sitting in 22nd.
keyPointsZh: 这是诺里斯2026赛季继布达佩斯之后的第二个杆位。
作为卫冕冠军车队，迈凯伦在赞德沃特赛道的每一节练习和排位赛中都占据首位。
诺里斯在Q2中同样排名第一。
keyPointsEn: As defending champions, McLaren topped every session at Zandvoort.
Norris was also fastest in Q2.
